_comment: Restaurants imported from their OWN sites (schema.org Restaurant JSON-LD): each becomes one 'Name · pickup' food event per open day for days_ahead days, with a read-only menu preview and a claim nudge. hours (0=Sun..6=Sat) overrides/fills a missing openingHoursSpecification; name fills a missing JSON-LD name. Restaurants with no hours from either source are skipped. Add entries like: {"url": "https://example-cafe.com", "name": "Example Cafe", "hours": {"days": [1,2,3,4,5], "open": "11:00", "close": "19:00"}}
